title: Marquis del Vasto to Charles V and the letter to "Garbino", 1527-28, BnF fr. 3022 nos. 6, 10, 20 (catalogue item 7)

steps.what: Fetched fr. 3022 (Gallica btv1b90601558) and identified the three catalogue pieces and folios.
Found no. 10 already solved by Lasry (2023) with Tomokiyo's edited text (2026), and Lasry's 2026 preliminary decryption of Cipher 2 covering no. 6 and no. 19.
Checked Lasry's no. 6 decryption against the f. 16v ciphertext (dʃfp = creo, nnbt = mas, qʃftxp = presto); identified no. 6 as del Vasto's own letter of early Dec 1527.

Identified about 40 b-/c-/d- code groups of no. 6 from context across nos. 6 and 19 (doz = Lautreque, deh = la Marca, dnb = dinero …) and made an edited reading (n6_reading.md); about 15 codes and some stretches open.
Transcribed no. 20 (1,315 groups) and ~2,600 groups of Ranzo's signed letters in fr. 2988; addition sheet transcribed (additione.json).
No. 20 code is initial letter + number, the number running in alphabetical order within each letter (solve.py, anchor.py).
Word annealer (solve2.py) on a held-out 3,900-word Castiglione control encoded the same way: ~46 % token, ~9 % type accuracy.
solve2.py on no. 20 + Ranzo: a stable function-word skeleton (che, il, per, non …) across six restarts; no content words.

Sought cribs: Clair. 327 and Clair. 314 copies (undeciphered), fr. 2988 other cipher pieces (a different French cipher), fr. 3019 no. 27 Ranzo letter (no decipherment), no duplicate text between no. 20 and Ranzo letters.
DECODE R1894 (catalogue 170) identified as the fr. 2988 Ranzo letter already transcribed; no key or decipherment on the record.

Kept Lasry's no. 6 decryption as a sign-level token list with a reading and status per token run (n6_signs.tsv); n6_measure.py checks the stream against Lasry's file and counts. Added the 5 'at quia' signs he left in <plaintext>.
First measurement of no. 6: Lasry's key alone 1,555/1,680 = 92.6%; with the 18 Sept code identifications 1,595/1,680 = 94.9%. The 18 Sept verdict 'read' had been unmeasured.

Checked the syllable-code signs on views 32-34 where a reading turned on the glyph: Lasry's two-per-syllable labels merge different signs. boz = esto (not fin), bab = mas, bar = tan, bop = como, bopt = ellos (Lasry 'con s'), bie = el (Lasry 'al'), bis = de, bep = es or en; <37> at 17va.11 is r.

Context readings (grade I): da = otro (not liga; nosotros, 'otro fruto'), dop = tiempo (not invierno), dab = tiene(n), <37> = final(mente), stop sign; 'at' and 'quia' identified as clear/cipher switch markers at every boundary in nos. 6 and 19.

Scanned no. 19 ff. 41r-41v on the images for the open groups; bet = dello from 'el poco cuidado que [bet] he' (f. 41v) fits no. 6 'exercito [bet]s tan pujante'. ff. 41-43 not transcribed in full; no other open group found.
Re-measured no. 6: 1,646/1,680 = 98.0% read; 11 nomenclator tokens (10 types: dnh, bnq, rar, car, cny, bny, beb, bnc, ge+, der at 17va.2) and 23 other tokens in 9 short stretches open.

outcome.fraction_read_source: Nos. 6 and 20 (no. 10 excluded: read by others, not reworked). No. 6: 1,646 of 1,680 cipher tokens read (n6_signs.tsv via n6_measure.py, 98.0%); no. 20: 0 of 1,321 groups (n20/f44r-f46v.txt). (1,646)/(1,680+1,321) = 0.5485. No. 6 alone meets the 95% bar; no. 20 is blocked (no key material).

gaps.item: No. 20 (Madrid, 11 Apr 1528, to Garbino), whole letter
gaps.detail: Ranzo's code is non-alphabetical; the annealer recovers only function words on a matched control. Needs Ranzo's base table or a clear copy (Garbino's side, Spanish/Italian archives, Gattinara's papers).

gaps.item: No. 6 code groups dnh, bnq, rar (x2), car, cny, bny, beb, bnc, ge+, der at 17va.2 (11 tokens)
gaps.detail: One or two contexts each, none fixing a value (rar Florencia or Luca; ge+ perhaps a stop). More contexts in no. 19 ff. 41-43, not transcribed in full.

gaps.item: No. 6 nine short stretches (23 tokens): 'y y por [mq]', 'es [en de las los]', '[es de] otro exercito', 'servira [que de con]', 'ira [que l] camino', '[der de] pais', 'en [cnt] parte', 'esperar [es]', 'apuntamiento [es]'
gaps.detail: Signs transcribed but the syllable-sign values do not make sense there; Lasry's labels probably merge different glyphs. Needs glyph-level retranscription.

gaps.item: No. 10: 47 queried words in Lasry/Tomokiyo's edited text
gaps.detail: Found read by others, not reworked, no sign transcription to measure.

outcome.notes: Per document: no. 6 read (98.0% measured, 22 Sept 2026; was 'read' unmeasured on 18 Sept); no. 10 read in part by Lasry/Tomokiyo, not measured; no. 20 not read. The target stays read in part because no. 20 is unread. Grades: 34 values inferred from context (24 code groups, 8 syllable signs, 2 switch markers); Lasry's letter key is taken as it stands. NOTES.md has '## Remaining gaps' and '## Escalation'.

prior.where: cryptiana GL.htm: Lasry 2023 / Tomokiyo 2026 reading of no. 10; Lasry 2026 preliminary letter-level decryption of no. 6 (Cipher 2). Nothing for no. 20.
